issue: The first 5186 browser run passed real output and HRTF checks, then sampled mute silence after a fixed 350ms. The analyser retains a 4096-sample window while master gain exponentially fades.
resolution: Wait for actual RMS below the same 0.000001 threshold, bounded at 3 seconds, and record pause/mute RMS. Product code and threshold remain unchanged; the original failed run is preserved.
